steps.content: Standing at the top of the Statue of Keylan, both of you can see those flickering lights and shadows. They seem like the Divine Lord's memories. But just like the oracles, they're too fragmented to understand.
Every time you see these memories, both of you feel pressured. You're still fine, but Yanyan has been overusing her Eastian sorcery these past few days and is looking sickly.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is this... the Divine Lord...?
As if responding to Yanyan's words, red light engulfs the top of the tower as powerful awe looms over everyone present. Even you begin to have a headache.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Divine Lord, can you hear my voice?
Upon seeing the golden light, Yanyan forces herself to stagger forward, trying to approach the glowing Divine Lord.
It's too dangerous. If the myth is true, the Divine Lord shouldn't be so irritable. If you let her go on, Yanyan will definitely be in danger!
Chirp, chirp!

You make to stop Yanyan when suddenly a chubby bird flies through the light and knocks Yanyan over. The red light fades, and the scene changes once more. This time, it seems everyone can see the strange spectacle.
Chirp... Chirp, chirp?
The chubby bird flutters up to a tree branch. It's hard to guess what it's trying to do.
People exchange looks of confusion. One of the braver soldiers stomps near the bird. Startled, it scurries down from the top of the tower, leaving behind only a few feathers.
...Chirp, chirp!
Before it flees, it doesn't forget to strut its stuff.
After the chubby bird runs away, Yanyan, who's been knocked over, seems to regain consciousness. You quickly help her up, but she can barely stand after overexerting her power.
You tell the diligent seer what happened just now. She seems a bit disheartened.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah, I see...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Did the Divine Lord reject Yanyan? If not... Why would it send a big fat bird to bump into Yanyan...
The girl becomes more and more aggrieved, tears already swirling in her eyes.

steps.speaker: jojo
steps.content: Yanyan isn't good enough... I've let everyone down...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's the Divine Lord. Look.
You pull out two golden feathers from your pocket and place them in Yanyan's palm.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is this...?
Yanyan looks at the feathers in her hand, clearly feeling the power harbored within them.
But she still can't believe that the big chubby bird is the formidable Divine Lord.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe both you and the Divine Lord are not that good at channeling?
You look at the array of items Yanyan has set up on the altar for channeling, then think of the Divine Lord who was scared off by the stomping feet of the FAC team soldiers.
You reach out and pat Yanyan's head.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Perhaps when you meet again, Yanyan will see the most majestic and powerful Divine Lord.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm... I hope so. Thank you, everyone, for accompanying Yanyan all the way here...
With that, Yanyan closes her eyes and falls asleep. Just as you're about to carry her away, someone steps forward to take the girl.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Chief, let me do it.
You hesitate for a moment.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief, he'll protect her well. You must be exhausted too. You can trust him, he's actually a pretty nice guy. He just likes to run his mouth.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: She collapsed because she tried so hard to protect DisCity. Whether or not she was talking childish nonsense, she's still a good kid.
The story has come to an end, and the hero has found the treasure. Whether the myth is true, what the Divine Lord really is... Let's leave that to the future Yanyan.
